channel.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
channel.description: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

item.title: Carín León looks every bit the macho Mexican superstar. But beneath is a romantic
item.description: Fresh off a six-night residency at Las Vegas's Sphere, Carín León is proving that even the toughest hombres have a soft spot — and a song for every wound.

item.title: Supreme Court recusals over books raise questions about policy
item.description: A publishing dispute has highlighted the issue of recusals by Supreme Court justices. We take a look at the court's policy and its impact.

item.title: How some states are preparing for the possibility of federal election interference
item.description: Two weeks before Election Day, some state officials are preparing for the possibility of interference in their elections by the federal government.

item.title: Beef producers could play a big role in this year's midterm elections
item.description: Trump's policies have complicated his support among beef producers, a key constituency in states where tight Senate races could sway control of the body.

item.title: Men speak out against sexual violence following Cornell rape story
item.description: The alleged gang rape at a Cornell University fraternity house has revived discussions on college campuses. We talked to some men who have been thinking and writing about this.

item.title: Asian-Americans report rise in hate speech tied to immigration
item.description: Stop AAPI hate has been tracking hate acts against Asian-Americans for years. researchers say that perpetrators are increasingly using anti-immigrant language mirroring Trump administration rhetoric.

item.title: Influencers are helping 'free birth' gain fans, despite medical risks
item.description: The practice known as "free birth" — giving birth at home without a midwife — carries severe risks. But social media influencers are bringing attention and followers to the practice.

item.title: Michigan's Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El Sayed campaigns in GOP stronghold
item.description: Michigan's Democratic U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is campaigning in the GOP stronghold of Michigan's Upper Peninsula, an area that hasn't voted for a Democrat in Congress in over a decade.

item.description: The Mississippi Attorney General says use of force was justified when a toddler died during a police shooting in June.

item.title: Oyster aid efforts in the Chesapeake
